_comment: Mac + IBKR paper. Copy to config.json. The Mac is the broker: this file cannot select tastytrade or Schwab. Port 7497 only. Orders go out only when mode is paper. mode dry stays dry. ./run.sh paper sets paper for one launch.
_entry_reprice: IBKR paper only. The flag does nothing in dry or alerts. max_add is the most the limit may rise above the original floored mid. It is also held to that order's original marketable debit. 0.40 is rejected. Live tastytrade and Schwab never reprice.
_rules: Version B only. 15m closes 12:00–1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Long nearest 75 delta. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. IBKR paper may raise the working limit by at most $0.10, one nickel at a time. GTC close at debit x 1.30. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop. Live Schwab orders are not this file.
_wrap: Read-only log summary at 16:20 ET: python -m spx_noon wrap. It does not send orders. Client id 142 is reserved and unused by that job.
